whyItMatters: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact.
actions: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm tox.ini no longer carries a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact.
